name: grid-pattern
title: Grid Pattern
description: A decorative SVG line grid that fills its positioned parent, with optional accent cells (`squares`, addressed as `[column, row]`) that can pulse. Colour comes from `currentColor`, so a text-colour class on `className` sets the tone.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/grid-pattern

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/grid-pattern.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/grid-pattern';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/grid-pattern

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
